statement: For the sextic Fourier model with actual-root pairings |E4|<=|E2|+2Delta and |E5|<=|E1|+2Delta, the branch |E1|+|E2|<=Delta has a strict same-parity staple whenever Delta=s^5 and s<=1/10. The selected rays and inner disk both have at least Delta/2 margin.
mechanism: Pairing gives a total nuisance budget 6Delta. The exact factorization t^6-6s^5t+5s^6=(t-s)^2(t^4+2st^3+3s^2t^2+4s^3t+5s^4) absorbs it uniformly.
claim_ceiling: This closes the paired low-mode coefficient branch and reduces its complement to |E1|+|E2|>Delta. It does not close the transverse branch, the origin-anchored remainder transfer, all sextics, or unrestricted Erdos #1041.
next_obligation: Normalize the transverse branch by the larger of the E1 and E2 balance radii, prove a finite compact selector using the existing sextic mixed atlas, and overlap its constants with this cone.
